title: Associate Account Director (Medical Communications & Marketing)
description:

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Real Chemistry is a global health innovation company with offices across EMEA, APAC and the US. We believe that the way to real, transformative change is through the uncommon combination of disciplines, technologies, and our greatest asset – our people. We are currently looking to add to our alchemic mix of more than 1,800 talented professionals. This is a great opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-growing global company committed to making the world a healthier place for all.

 

Job Summary

Real Chemistry Germany is looking for a strong Associate Account Director to join our team, acting as the day-to-day account lead across accounts in medical affairs, marketing and comms. title: AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The AI Enablement team supports the adoption of AI capabilities across Raisin’s products and internal systems.

The team focuses on establishing a consistent and reliable approach to using AI in production by providing shared foundations, guidance, and reusable solutions. This includes working with engineering teams to integrate AI into existing systems, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with security and regulatory requirements.

The scope ranges from improving internal workflows to enabling new product capabilities, depending on where AI can deliver measurable value.


Your Responsibilities

As an AI Engineer, you will help shape how AI is applied across the organization by combining hands-on engineering with enablement and guidance.

Enable teams to adopt AI effectively

 This role will be based out of either Sydney or Melbourne, Australia.

title: Engineering Manager - Customer Developer Experience
description:
About Constructor
Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.
 About the Role As an Engineering Manager on the Customer Developer Experience (CDX) team, you'll lead engineers whose work spans two fronts: partnering directly with the external developers integrating our platform to provide hands-on technical guidance, and building the advanced open-source tooling that makes those integrations effortless. Constructor’s open source technology is utilized on millions of end user devices and are crucial to powering the most innovative product discovery experiences in the industry.
 You'll set the technical strategy for our open-source tooling and how it advances the experience of the external developers who build on our platform. Keeping their trust means keeping our libraries reliable, high-quality, and well-documented, and that ownership sits with you.
 Challenges you will tackle Cross functional collaboration and prioritization: close collaboration with product, customer success, data science and other engineering teams to prioritize features and address customer needs effectively.
 Balancing support and delivery : allocating the team's capacity across hands-on integration support and long-term tooling development, so that neither the customers in front of you nor the platform work that scales the whole business gets starved.
 Recruiting and hiring : owning the hiring process for your team end to end, from building a strong pipeline to running an effective interview loop and closing the engineers you want.
 Career growth : guiding the development of the engineers on your team, giving direct feedback, creating opportunities that stretch them, and helping them work through the obstacles that come up along the way.
